\section*{Problem 8}

From Figure 1, the match columns are \(1,2,3\) and the insert region is the contiguous block between match positions \(2\) and \(3\). The five aligned sequences are
\[
\begin{array}{c|cccccc}
 & M_1 & M_2 & I & I & I & M_3\\
\hline
\text{bat}  & A & G & - & - & - & C\\
\text{rat}  & A & - & A & G & - & C\\
\text{cat}  & A & G & - & - & - & C\\
\text{gnat} & - & G & A & A & A & C\\
\text{goat} & A & G & - & - & A & C
\end{array}
\]

\subsection*{1. Match emission probabilities}

Using the add-one estimate
\[
E_i(a)=\frac{N_i(a)+1}{\sum_{a' \in \{A,C,G,T\}} (N_i(a')+1)},
\]
we obtain:

\paragraph{Position \(1\):}
Observed symbols: \(A,A,A,-,A\), so
\[
N_1(A)=4,\qquad N_1(C)=N_1(G)=N_1(T)=0.
\]
Hence
\[
E_1(A)=\frac{5}{8},\qquad
E_1(C)=E_1(G)=E_1(T)=\frac{1}{8}.
\]

\paragraph{Position \(2\):}
Observed symbols: \(G,-,G,G,G\), so
\[
N_2(G)=4,\qquad N_2(A)=N_2(C)=N_2(T)=0.
\]
Hence
\[
E_2(G)=\frac{5}{8},\qquad
E_2(A)=E_2(C)=E_2(T)=\frac{1}{8}.
\]

\paragraph{Position \(3\):}
Observed symbols: \(C,C,C,C,C\), so
\[
N_3(C)=5,\qquad N_3(A)=N_3(G)=N_3(T)=0.
\]
Hence
\[
E_3(C)=\frac{6}{9}=\frac{2}{3},\qquad
E_3(A)=E_3(G)=E_3(T)=\frac{1}{9}.
\]

Therefore,
\[
\boxed{
E_1=(A:\tfrac58,\ C:\tfrac18,\ G:\tfrac18,\ T:\tfrac18)
}
\]
\[
\boxed{
E_2=(A:\tfrac18,\ C:\tfrac18,\ G:\tfrac58,\ T:\tfrac18)
}
\]
\[
\boxed{
E_3=(A:\tfrac19,\ C:\tfrac23,\ G:\tfrac19,\ T:\tfrac19)
}
\]

\subsection*{2. Insert emission probabilities}

All three insert columns belong to the same insert state \(I_2\). Ignoring gaps, the insert emissions are:
\[
\text{rat}: A,G,\qquad
\text{gnat}: A,A,A,\qquad
\text{goat}: A.
\]
So the counts are
\[
N_{I_2}(A)=5,\qquad N_{I_2}(G)=1,\qquad N_{I_2}(C)=N_{I_2}(T)=0.
\]

Using the same add-one smoothing,
\[
E_{I_2}(a)=\frac{N_{I_2}(a)+1}{\sum_{a' \in \{A,C,G,T\}} (N_{I_2}(a')+1)},
\]
we get
\[
E_{I_2}(A)=\frac{6}{10}=\frac35,\qquad
E_{I_2}(G)=\frac{2}{10}=\frac15,\qquad
E_{I_2}(C)=E_{I_2}(T)=\frac{1}{10}.
\]

Thus
\[
\boxed{
E_{I_2}=(A:\tfrac35,\ C:\tfrac1{10},\ G:\tfrac15,\ T:\tfrac1{10})
}
\]

\medskip

For the other insert states \(I_0,I_1,I_3\), there are no observed insert emissions in the alignment, so with add-one smoothing they are uniform:
\[
\boxed{
E_{I_0}=E_{I_1}=E_{I_3}=(A:\tfrac14,\ C:\tfrac14,\ G:\tfrac14,\ T:\tfrac14)
}
\]

\subsection*{3. Transition probabilities}

We use
\[
T_i(k\to \ell)=\frac{N_i(k\to \ell)+1}{\sum_{\ell' \in \{M,I,D\}} \bigl(N_i(k\to \ell')+1\bigr)}.
\]

\paragraph{Observed state paths}
The five sequences correspond to:

\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{bat}:&\quad M_0 \to M_1 \to M_2 \to M_3 \to M_4,\\
\text{rat}:&\quad M_0 \to M_1 \to D_2 \to I_2 \to I_2 \to M_3 \to M_4,\\
\text{cat}:&\quad M_0 \to M_1 \to M_2 \to M_3 \to M_4,\\
\text{gnat}:&\quad M_0 \to D_1 \to M_2 \to I_2 \to I_2 \to I_2 \to M_3 \to M_4,\\
\text{goat}:&\quad M_0 \to M_1 \to M_2 \to I_2 \to M_3 \to M_4.
\end{aligned}
\]

\paragraph{Position \(i=0\): from Begin (\(M_0\))}
Counts:
\[
N_0(M\to M)=4,\qquad N_0(M\to I)=0,\qquad N_0(M\to D)=1.
\]
Therefore
\[
\boxed{
T_0(M\to M)=\frac58,\quad
T_0(M\to I)=\frac18,\quad
T_0(M\to D)=\frac14
}
\]

\paragraph{Position \(i=1\): from states at position 1 to position 2}
From \(M_1\):
\[
N_1(M\to M)=3,\qquad N_1(M\to I)=0,\qquad N_1(M\to D)=1,
\]
so
\[
\boxed{
T_1(M\to M)=\frac47,\quad
T_1(M\to I)=\frac17,\quad
T_1(M\to D)=\frac27
}
\]

From \(D_1\):
\[
N_1(D\to M)=1,\qquad N_1(D\to I)=0,\qquad N_1(D\to D)=0,
\]
so
\[
\boxed{
T_1(D\to M)=\frac12,\quad
T_1(D\to I)=\frac14,\quad
T_1(D\to D)=\frac14
}
\]

There are no observed transitions from \(I_1\), so with add-one smoothing:
\[
\boxed{
T_1(I\to M)=T_1(I\to I)=T_1(I\to D)=\frac13
}
\]

\paragraph{Position \(i=2\): from states at position 2 to position 3}
From \(M_2\):
\[
N_2(M\to M)=2,\qquad N_2(M\to I)=2,\qquad N_2(M\to D)=0,
\]
so
\[
\boxed{
T_2(M\to M)=\frac37,\quad
T_2(M\to I)=\frac37,\quad
T_2(M\to D)=\frac17
}
\]

From \(D_2\):
\[
N_2(D\to M)=0,\qquad N_2(D\to I)=1,\qquad N_2(D\to D)=0,
\]
so
\[
\boxed{
T_2(D\to M)=\frac14,\quad
T_2(D\to I)=\frac12,\quad
T_2(D\to D)=\frac14
}
\]

From \(I_2\):
\[
N_2(I\to M)=3,\qquad N_2(I\to I)=3,\qquad N_2(I\to D)=0,
\]
since there are three exits from \(I_2\) to \(M_3\) and three self-loops in \(I_2\). Hence
\[
\boxed{
T_2(I\to M)=\frac49,\quad
T_2(I\to I)=\frac49,\quad
T_2(I\to D)=\frac19
}
\]

\paragraph{Position \(i=3\): from states at position 3 to End (\(M_4\))}
All observed paths go from \(M_3\) to End, so
\[
N_3(M\to M)=5,\qquad N_3(M\to I)=0,\qquad N_3(M\to D)=0,
\]
and thus
\[
\boxed{
T_3(M\to M)=\frac34,\quad
T_3(M\to I)=\frac18,\quad
T_3(M\to D)=\frac18
}
\]

There are no observed transitions from \(D_3\) or \(I_3\), so with add-one smoothing:
\[
\boxed{
T_3(D\to M)=T_3(D\to I)=T_3(D\to D)=\frac13
}
\]
\[
\boxed{
T_3(I\to M)=T_3(I\to I)=T_3(I\to D)=\frac13
}
\]
